$comment: Settings for scripts/fetch-publications.mjs. Edit this file (not the script) to
change what ends up on the 'All publications' page, then re-run `npm run publications`
or trigger the 'Update publications' workflow on GitHub.
'strict'   - only works where the group member's OWN authorship line carries a CWI
affiliation. Most precise, but arXiv preprints are dropped because
arXiv does not supply affiliation data at all.
'balanced' - (default) a work counts when CWI appears anywhere on it, OR when the
work carries no institutional metadata whatsoever (which is how
arXiv preprints look). Members flagged "strict" in members.json are
always evaluated strictly, whatever this setting says.
'any'      - every work by every listed member, regardless of affiliation.
fromYear: drop anything published before this year. null = no cut-off.
types:    OpenAlex work types to keep. Note that every archived GitHub release shows
